name: Beef Lasagna Noodle Soup with Carrots, Spinach & Basil
ingredients: 40 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add beef, carrots, and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until almost cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, break lasagna noodles into bite-sized pieces.

When the beef is done, add noodles, broth, and tomato sauce to the pot; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer until noodles start to soften, 7-8 minutes.
While the soup is cooking, wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems; roll up crosswise and thinly slice into ribbons.

Add spinach and half of the basil to the pot (reserve remaining basil for serving). Return soup to a simmer and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until spinach is warmed through and noodles are tender, 3-4 minutes more.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and top with reserved basil. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
